title: Body Talk
notes: Unhurried, sensual keyboard soul and low-slung disco grooves, punctuated by dance-floor breakthroughs.

title: In the Heat of the Night
notes: Sleek synthesizer-led club soul, liquid bass lines, sustained grooves and serene falsetto.

title: Night Dubbing
scene: British club remixes / Paradise Garage-era dance
notes: Studio reworks foreground cavernous echoes, punched snares, unstable passages and Larry Levan’s Changes.

title: Scandalous
notes: Glossy dance-soul softens earlier grit, though extended grooves and synthesizers remain.
